claim_ladder.claim: A content-specific active-plan component causally controls the first post-reset plan-relevant branch under matched observable state.
claim_ladder.go: Run pre-frozen family-disjoint T1 replication; do not alter layer/alpha.
minimum_evidence: canonical v2.4 confirmation passes all frozen validity/expressivity/sign/Holm/effect/bidirectionality gates
claim_ladder.no_go: Valid null/weak specificity -> weaken single-site contrast mechanism; do not rescue via retuning.

claim_ladder.claim: The T1 causal branch-control effect is robust to disjoint task families within the same model/environment.
minimum_evidence: pre-frozen 20-family train reserve passes identical no-retuning gates
claim_ladder.no_go: Do not promote high-tier general mechanism claim; investigate cohort dependence prospectively.

claim_ladder.claim: A single restored plan carrier persists causally across >=1 identical action/observation cycle without reinjection and affects a later plan branch.
minimum_evidence: later reciprocal branch effect beyond controls
claim_ladder.no_go: Classify FAIL_PERSISTENCE: T1 was transient action/branch steering, not plan memory.

claim_ladder.claim: An endogenous pre-interruption plan state can be checkpointed/restored with meaningful compression/minimality and retained causal function.
claim_ladder.go: Second model family + second environment replication.
claim_ladder.no_go: Do not sell compact memory; retain narrower mechanistic result if valid.

claim_ladder.claim: The mechanism generalizes across model family and environment and supports end-to-end interruption robustness.
claim_ladder.no_go: Scope paper to mechanistic findings actually replicated.

do_not_do: do not place published numbers from different models/tasks into one table as if directly comparable
do not call k<=32 compact without global-basis amortization
do not use a stronger model for our method than baselines
fairness: report actual text tokens + latent storage bytes/bits + global learned/shared overhead
separate reported-literature context from our matched reruns
matched_baselines: matched latent-memory method(s) reproducible on same model/task/hardware
end_to_end_baseline_policy.when: Only after T1R and T2 support; do not spend core compute on performance benchmarking before the mechanism survives.

mechanism_comparisons.name: UNRELATED_PLAN
mechanism_comparisons.role: plan-specificity null with frozen independent donor

mechanism_comparisons.name: PREFIX_ONLY_REENCODE
mechanism_comparisons.role: later-state/text leakage control; destroys carried latent state while preserving later observable state

principle: Do not promote a later-rung claim from evidence collected for an earlier rung. A positive T1 is causal branch control, not memory; latent-memory performance is prior art and cannot be the novelty claim.

prior_art_boundary.already_covers: decoding/localization and activation patching of future-plan information
prior_art_boundary.family: Where’s the Plan? / causal planning localization
prior_art_boundary.our_required_difference: interrupted embodied-agent active-plan identity, matched-world transplant, later persistence
episode-specific active-plan semantic identity and interruption persistence
causally identified plan carrier rather than generic memory/guidance

prior_art_boundary.already_covers: state-conditioned/learned latent memory for embodied agents and ALFWorld-like performance
prior_art_boundary.our_required_difference: causal plan-state identification/checkpoint/restore; ALFWorld gains alone are not novelty

reviewer_go_no_go.question: Could T1 be mere order-token steering?
reviewer_go_no_go.required_answer: ARCHIVED_ORDER + lexical matching + bidirectional active contrast must separate it.

reviewer_go_no_go.question: Could T1 be generic activation sensitivity?
reviewer_go_no_go.required_answer: RANDOM_SAME_NORM + UNRELATED_PLAN specificity and competence guards.

reviewer_go_no_go.question: Could T1 be immediate-action copying rather than plan state?
Could novelty just be latent memory?
reviewer_go_no_go.required_answer: No; paper framing and experiments center causal identification/persistence; MemCompiler/ElasticMem/etc. are explicit prior-art boundaries.

reviewer_go_no_go.question: Could compression claim ignore shared basis cost?
reviewer_go_no_go.required_answer: Report basis k*d*precision, per-episode coefficients/checkpoint, raw state, amortization and text-token baseline.
